Its mention of 'documentation and marketing' only concerns distinguishing classes, not where the identifier is used. It also does not explicitly present sub-fund-level identification as an alternative, though it does not deny it. The bundle is substantive but incomplete.

This optional point is not addressed: the answer does not say class-level identification predated 2026. It also does not claim the permission was first introduced in 2026, so there is no falsehood. Optional omissions do not reduce the grade.
